decision: Test whether exact positive-anchor GAR is the simplest stable recipe. The seed-0 expert checkpoint is healthy and improves deployment-feasible current-buffer horizon-2 normalized edit distance by 0.0656, while depth-2 replay fraction 0.25 collapses on seed 2 (effective rank 7.16). First evaluate the already-terminal replay-plus-positive-anchor checkpoint at the fixed horizon-2 protocol. Independently train expert positive-anchor seeds 1 and 2 at lr 0.004. Continue only if both replications remain healthy (effective rank at least 50, finite losses, token-aligned shuffled-action error ratio above 1) and a subsequent fixed-protocol planning audit confirms positive improvement on both; otherwise reject the recipe as seed-unstable. Treat all positive-anchor training selection and oracle-injected planning conditions as candidate-privileged diagnostics, not deployment evidence.
